pages.text: The path to discovering all bee species is a long one, built upon combining simpler species to create more complex ones.$(br2)This entry serves as a reference for the primary breeding paths. Remember that each cross-breed has a specific chance of success; sometimes you will just get one of the parent species back.

pages.title: Tier 1
pages.text: $(li)Mossy = Dirt + Stone$(li)Lumber = Dirt + Water$(li)Honey = Water + Sand

pages.title: Tier 2
pages.text: $(li)Coal = Stone + Lumber$(li)Resin = Lumber + Honey$(li)Farming = Mossy + Lumber$(li)Mining = Stone + Gravel

pages.title: Tier 3 (Metals)
pages.text: $(li)Copper = Gravel + Coal$(li)Iron = Stone + Coal$(li)Gold = Sand + Iron

pages.title: High Tier & Endgame
pages.text: $(li)Fighting = Iron + Bone$(li)Emerald = Lapis + Farming$(li)Diamond = Gold + Coal$(li)Ancient Debris = Diamond + Netherrack
